subject: Coordination: Partner incentive evidence & listing renewal for NimbusCloud
messages:
From: Priya Desai <priya@NimbusCloud.io>
To: david_kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Mariana Lopez <mariana@nimbuscloud.io>
Date: Thu, 19 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: evidence package for listing incentive renewal (FY27)

Hi David —

Hope you’re well. NimbusCloud is approaching our annual marketplace program renewal with AWS and we want to confirm eligibility for the listing fee credit and co-sell incentive tiers for FY27. AWS requires a short evidence package from Redwood showing:

- Quarterly sell-through by SKU (last 4 quarters)
- Customer references for at least 3 new ARR wins tied to marketplace flow
- Redirect/ingestion proof for any billing metering (if applicable)

I’ve attached our internal performance dashboard to show the threshold we’re aiming for (Partner_Performance_Dashboard_Q1.pdf). Can Redwood provide the above evidence and a proposed fee-split for co-sell credits that we can submit to AWS by 4/26?

We’d like to keep the same listing tier but need the documentation to secure the incentive credits and avoid a fee reset. If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute sync this week.

Thanks —
Priya Desai
Head of Cloud Partnerships, NimbusCloud
priya@nimbuscloud.io
Mobile: +1 415-555-0139

Attachment: Partner_Performance_Dashboard_Q1.pdf (reference)

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the note and the dashboard. We can put together the evidence package, but we need to align internally on what counts as "sell-through" for this program and who owns which pieces of the fee-split. Action items from our side:

1) I will compile the quarter-by-quarter marketplace revenue and order IDs for the last four quarters and provide a CSV export (redwood export).
2) Vanessa — can you surface three customer references that were acquired via marketplace listing (name + short quote + contact)?
3) Camila — can you confirm metering/billing flow for Nimbus SKUs (any redirected billing, marketplace metering IDs)?
4) Aditya — finance needs a suggested fee-split and a short rationale (spreadsheet) we can propose to AWS.

Priya — our target is to deliver the full evidence packet plus the proposed fee-split by COB 4/24 so you have time to submit to AWS. If that timeline works, I’ll book a 30-minute slot for Friday to review.

Quick note: we’ll include the AWS listing guidance PDF as part of the packet and flag anything that might need their program team to confirm.

Best,
David Kim

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: david_kim@redwoodinference.com, camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 19 Apr 2028 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Draft fee-split proposal and customer refs for NimbusCloud renewal

Folks —

Pulling threads here after David’s ask. I reviewed Nimbus’s dashboard and sketched a fee-split that balances Redwood’s unit economics while keeping Nimbus at the incentive thresholds they need. Draft highlights (see attached Proposed_Fee_Split_Sheet.xlsx):

- Proposed base split: 72/28 (Redwood/Nimbus) for direct marketplace transactions where Redwood handles the runtime and metering.
- Co-sell uplift band (when Redwood-field motion or joint pipeline closes): additional 10% uplift to Nimbus for deals originated by Nimbus+marketplace flow (needs attribution proof).
- Credit clawback: 3-month grace window for any chargebacks or refund adjustments.

Customer references: I have two confirmed (ACME Retail, FlowOps) and one in-flight (EcoBank — awaiting buyer intro). I’ll share short quotes and contact permissions by EOW.

Camila — confirm whether any of Nimbus’s SKUs are on a redirected billing route (this affects whether AWS treats the transactions as marketplace-sourced). If they are redirected, we need the meter IDs and proof-of-ingestion logs.

Aditya — can you model the impact of the proposed split on Redwood’s FY27 marketplace gross margin and whether we can make a one-time listing-credit to help Nimbus keep the same tier? I suspect a small credit will preserve the partnership and net positive ARR.

I’ll prepare language for the packet so Nimbus can submit to AWS without customization.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: Proposed_Fee_Split_Sheet.xlsx

From: Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@aws.amazon.com>
To: david_kim@redwoodinference.com, Priya Desai <priya@NimbusCloud.io>
Cc: Mariana Lopez <mariana@nimbuscloud.io>, irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 20 Apr 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: evidence package for listing incentive renewal (FY27)

Hi David and Priya —

Thanks for the packet draft and for looping us in. A few clarifications from the AWS Partner Programs side:

- Sell-through: we accept marketplace order IDs tied to a validated seller account and invoice records. CSV with order_id, purchase_date, sku, buyer_org, and gross_value is sufficient.
- Customer refs: three distinct customer contacts with explicit confirmation they purchased via the marketplace is mandatory. Short email quotes or intake form responses are fine.
- Redirected billing: if billing is redirected (seller invoices directly and AWS only handles listing), the transaction may not count as marketplace-sourced for incentive tiers. Metering IDs and ingestion logs will help, but sometimes we require a short systems attestation.

Outcome: If Redwood submits the CSV export + three customer confirmations + the proposed fee-split, I can escalate to the incentive review committee for an expedited decision. We will require a signed program amendment (DocuSign). I’m attaching the DocuSign envelope link here for a one-off amendment once terms are agreed: https://www.docusign.net/ENVELOPEID/0a1b2c3d

Please let me know if you want the committee to do a quick intake call on 4/25 AM.

Regards,
Ethan Shaw
Partner Programs, AWS Marketplace
ethan.shaw@aws.amazon.com
